decks.label: Lydrette ord · 3 lyde
decks.comboAudit: All 128 combinations (8 onsets × 4 vowels × 4 codas) enumerated and screened for vulgar/slur/anatomy/alcohol surfaces. Flagged sensitive: tis (children's word for pee — real but giggle-bait), gin (alcohol), nos (fragment of the vulgar plural 'nosser'), bol (imperative of the vulgar verb 'bolle'; the innocent bun sense is the noun 'bolle', never bare 'bol'). mus kept real with badge: the mouse sense is THE canonical Danish first-reading word (Søren og Mette class); the slang sense was weighed and dismissed. lort/pik/fis-class words are structurally unbuildable (no d/g/r/t/f codas or onsets as needed). Real-but-rare RO/DDO forms deliberately left as robot words after review: sul, bum, bis, lin, lom, las, gol, gom, tus, hin, sot — a børnehaveklasse teacher will not miss them, and a false 'vrøvleord' on an archaism is harmless. No slur is composable in this space.
decks.notes: NATIVE RULING on final -t: EXCLUDED. Word-final /t/ in Danish de-aspirates to [d̥] (hat ≈ 'had'), and beginning spellers systematically write final t as d — the classic 'kad' error — so -t codas are not lydret enough for børnehaveklassen under a maximally conservative bar. This card set also has no k onset, so the one canonical t-word payoff (kat) is unbuildable regardless, and a t coda would add 'gat' (vulgar) to the combo space. Codas restricted to the four stable continuants s/l/n/m; no d/g/r/v/t codas (blødt d, blødt g, r-vokalisering, affrikering). Vowel note: u lowers toward [ɔ] before l (hul, nul) — both are unambiguously real words and stay classified real, but the chain deliberately routes through drift-free words only. nonwordTTS false CONFIRMED: Danish TTS is marginal even on real words; robot words stay silent and live in the teacher's mouth.

decks.label: To lyde · korte ord
decks.comboAudit: All 36 combinations (6 onsets × 6 vowels) enumerated and screened for vulgar/slur/anatomy/alcohol surfaces. Flagged sensitive: so (real farm word — a sow — but also a common insult aimed at women; kept real for the farm sense, excluded from chains and celebrations). Every other combo is clean: robot set kå, ki, ku, ky, su, tu, bå, bu, mo, mø, mi, mu, my, no, nø screened word by word — none vulgar. mø (archaic maiden) and the interjection spellings bu/muh-class left as robot by the rare/archaic rule; bø (the boo! interjection, DDO) kept real — children love it.
decks.notes: Open CV syllables: every vowel is long and true to its letter sound, so this is the phonetically cleanest deck in the Danish set — no soft-d, no soft-g, no r, no vowel drift anywhere in the space. 21 of 36 combos are real words (to, ti, ni are number words; ko, sø, bi carry picture badges). Designed as the very first sammentrækning experience: two cards, two sounds, one word.
